blocker.message: No contract-conformant physical A6-OTT executor or Slurm launcher exists. experiments/a6_ott.py exposes only --dry-run and explicitly refuses physical execution.
blocker.unsafe_alternative_rejected: scripts/basis_a6_execute.py is the superseded 70,080-cell atlas executor; it writes the legacy namespace and schedules Raw, Minus-Shared, U-S, Conditioning-All, fixed-vector, and five-rho work.
required_before_execution: Implement a compact phase-aware physical executor under the A6-OTT namespace.
Wire result-first cell indexing and IN_FLIGHT ownership.
Add compact Slurm submission with a maximum of two concurrent jobs.
Implement Phase-A selection, conditional Qwen rescue, Phase-B freeze, and Phase-C unlocks.
